verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail sells its mailbox address alongside several entity and address services from one provider. These include TruLease (a commercial office address backed by a one-year lease and optional utility bill), TruResidence (a verified U.S. residential address), a free registered agent with all mailbox plans, and TruStart LLC guidance. However, LLC formation is offered only as self-paced DIY video tutorials and templates, not as a done-for-you filing service. Missing for 10: actual LLC formation filing service, explicit documentation of foreign qualification use for TruLease, independent or hands-on corroboration.
